text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (Visible emotions. The heart hidden behind them. ...How truly complex it is.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Behind that serious expression lies 'affection.'
...However, what if... behind even that...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master.
Today, I will take care of you.

As soon as Mihono Bourbon got out of the bath,
those were the first words out of her mouth.

I was taken aback for a moment, but her
'understanding of emotions' has grown rapidly of late.
Maybe this time, too...
choice_data_list: ...All right, I guess I'll leave it to you, then!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Executing plan: Cherish Master.
First, scanning your condition.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Mild dark circles and slight skin roughness detected.
Inferred to be caused by work-related fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, let us first warm up in the hot springs.
After that, I shall handle the rest."
choice_data_list: Oh, you're very observant... That helps a lot!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...With this waterfall bath,
Master's blood circulation should improve as well...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Stiffness in the body lowers the quality of sleep.
Let's stretch while your muscles are still warm.
Excuse me.
(Whirrrr~~...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Danger: Significant stiffness detected along the medial border of the scapula.
Decreasing intensity, meticulously loosening tissue, and releasing adhesions between the scapula and muscles.
(Chug... Chug... Chug...)
choice_data_list: Oh, that pressure feels just right...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master's relaxation confirmed.
Status: "Soothed." ...Continuing protocol.

Mihono Bourbon expertly massaged my muscles,
making my body feel completely light again...!
choice_data_list: This is exactly what I've been yearning for...!
This is exactly what I've been yearning for...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master's elevated mood detected.
Predicted state: "Good humor."
............

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Confirming line of sight of Master.
You are focusing on a souvenir shop.
Pickles are lined up at the storefront.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Inferred to be caused by perspiration while bathing.
Replenishing minerals is recommended.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Proposal: How about we have "lunch"
first? We might also be able to
replenish our pickle supply.
choice_data_list: I've got you figured out—I can read your feelings and what's coming next!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ......Motion. 'Good response.'
And so, the time spent being "pampered" by Mihono Bourbon passed by...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Executing Master's desires.
80% of today's active hours have elapsed.
I shall continue execution until the end.
choice_data_list: You've already taken such good care of me...!

text_block_list.text:
A fluffy, warm, sweet steam tickles my nose.
It's an onsen manju.
choice_data_list: (Bourbon likes sweets, so as a thank-you gift...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master's state of mind detected.
You are "feeling a little peckish," correct?
choice_data_list: Ah... No, I was just thinking of buying it for Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my.
It seems I miscalculated.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, no error correction is required. Processing as "unavoidable."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Because reading a person's emotions
completely is impossible.
choice_data_list: ...Mind if I ask for more details?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...The 'sadness' behind a smile.
The 'loneliness' behind anger.
The 'affection' behind a stern expression.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Depending on the angle you look at it, the heart changes shape.
It is difficult to read completely.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...However, I learned that if you face things earnestly,
there are always insights to be gained."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master. Behind your troubled expression,
I detect "affection"... and behind that,
I have found one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...'Devotion.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"To hold something dear,
even if subconsciously,
you end up offering something in return."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you, gazing at me, didn't realize it,
I—seeing you like that, felt a pain 'right here.'"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Which is why I want to look closely too.
I want to cherish you properly."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, I have a feeling my 'anxiety'...
will transform into an entirely different emotion."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...May I proceed with the execution?

Reading someone's heart is difficult. However,
if you look with earnest sincerity, you will surely notice its colors.

The two of us munched on onsen manju,
thinking about "the heart" under the autumn harvest moon—
